name: vicky-skills
description: Approved Given / When / Then examples as the spec a build must pass, and a guard on approved tests

guard_pr.title: One pull request per effort, and no AI credit
guard_pr.description: Keep each session's effort to one pull request, opened once: a new one opens only stacked on it, labelled stacked, on a big enough pull request or as separate work. Also refuse a gh, tea or git-spice command whose text, or the body file it sends, credits an AI.

guard_pr_stack_min_lines.title: Lines before a follow-up may stack
guard_pr_stack_min_lines.description: How many lines a pull request changes before pr-guard lets a follow-up stack on it, unless the follow-up says it is separate work.

guard_pr_stack_limit.title: Pull requests in one stack
guard_pr_stack_limit.description: The most open pull requests one session's stack holds.

guard_issue_threads.title: Read whole threads
guard_issue_threads.description: Refuse an issue or pull request view that leaves out its comments.

guard_tea_stdin.title: Close tea's stdin
guard_tea_stdin.description: Refuse a tea command that leaves stdin open, since tea blocks on it and a retry can post twice.

guard_heavy_run.title: Cap the memory of heavy runs
guard_heavy_run.description: Refuse pkill -f, which also kills the shell running it. Refuse an image, video, render or build run (ImageMagick, Real-ESRGAN, ffmpeg, Blender, sd-cli, dotnet build or test, python on image work, nix develop -c) that no systemd-run MemoryMax= cap wraps, and give the command with the cap in place. Short reads such as magick identify pass. A repo lists scripts that cap themselves on a 'Bounded scripts:' line in docs/agents/.

guard_gate_state.title: Check a gate's pull requests before it is sent
guard_gate_state.description: Refuse a message that opens with the gate line when a pull request it names has already merged or closed, so a gate is never reported from memory. Looks each one up with gh on GitHub and tea elsewhere, and lets the message through when a lookup fails.

guard_plane_block.title: Plane blocks need a hard reason
guard_plane_block.description: Refuse 'plane block' unless the command ends with '# hard: <reason>'. Plane's API can't remove a blocked-by link, so the hook sends a softer order to a 'Waits on:' line in the body.

guard_local_paths.title: No local paths in commits
guard_local_paths.description: Refuse a commit that adds your home folder, username or another machine-specific path.

local_path_exempt_repos.title: Repos allowed to hold local paths
local_path_exempt_repos.description: Space-separated owner/repo names the local-path guard skips, such as a dotfiles repo.

guard_git.title: Git branches, pushes and commits
guard_git.description: Refuse a new branch on top of unmerged work, a push to main or master, a commit message that credits an AI, and a commit that sets its own author or committer. In a trunk repo, a push to main runs and a new branch is refused.

git_guard_trunk_repos.title: Trunk repos for the git guard
git_guard_trunk_repos.description: Repos that take every change on main, as owner/repo, separated by commas, for a repo that can't hold a "Trunk: on" line in its AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or docs/agents.

guard_push_behind.title: No push from behind main
guard_push_behind.description: Refuse a push from a branch that lacks the tip of origin's default branch.

guard_worktree_place.title: Worktrees in each repo's .claude/worktrees
guard_worktree_place.description: Refuse git worktree add outside the repo's own .claude/worktrees folder, and keep that folder out of git status. After a git merge, remove the merged branch's worktree and branch once every commit has landed and nothing is uncommitted.

guard_checkout.title: One session per checkout
guard_checkout.description: Refuse a branch switch, or a git command that writes history, in a checkout another session used in the last 12 hours, so the session works in its own worktree. Tell a session when its checkout moved to another branch under it. Each session's last git command per checkout is kept in the plugin's data folder until the session ends.

guard_red_first.title: Approved tests land first
guard_red_first.description: Refuse a commit that adds a new approved-examples test together with any other change, so the tests land red in a commit of their own.

guard_mutation_proof.title: No commit with a stale mutation proof
guard_mutation_proof.description: Refuse a commit while the repo's mutation proof is out of date, in a repo whose docs/agents/testing.md names a 'Mutation proof check:' command.

guard_draft_lock.title: No code while a draft is open
guard_draft_lock.description: While red-pen has a draft open in your editor, refuse edits to the repo's files. Writes outside the repo, such as scratch files, still run.

gamma_shift.title: Gamma shift at session start (experimental)
gamma_shift.description: The experimental backlog-clearing powerhouse. Use it with care. off does nothing. remind says how many tickets wait on you. engage works with no one watching: it builds every ticket whose wait is over, runs spark-joy and the drift check on their schedules below, puts all of it on one draft pull request, and comments on tickets.

auto_tidy.title: Tidy merged branches at session start
auto_tidy.description: When a local branch's upstream is gone, ask the agent to run marie-kondo before its first reply. When the clone stands on a merged branch, hand it back to main.

familiar_kind.title: Familiar: its kind
familiar_kind.description: The voice /familiar speaks in: owl (the default), imp, quasit, raven, parrot, pseudodragon, cat or spider. Every kind does the same work.

deepen_every_days.title: Gamma shift: deepen the code every few days
deepen_every_days.description: Runs only when gamma_shift is engage. A spark-joy run joins the gamma shift at the first session start in a repo after this many days, 7 by default. 0 turns it off.

drift_every_days.title: Gamma shift: check tickets for drift every few days
drift_every_days.description: Runs only when gamma_shift is engage. The ticket-drift agent joins the gamma shift at the first session start in a repo after this many days, 7 by default. It comments on open tickets whose comments or merged pull requests contradict their body, and edits nothing. 0 turns it off.

skill_ledger.title: Keep a ledger of skill starts
skill_ledger.description: Add one line per skill start, the time and the skill's name, to a file in the plugin's data folder on this machine. captains-log reads it to find skills nobody starts.

reader_panel.title: Reader panel on big drafts
reader_panel.description: How human-voice runs the panel of readers on a draft over about 400 words: one agent playing every seat, or one agent per seat, run side by side.

gate_notify.title: Notify when an agent waits on you
gate_notify.description: Raise a desktop notification when an agent's message opens with the gate line, and on Claude Code's own alerts except the idle one. Uses notify-send, or osascript on macOS.

nwn_blender.title: Blender for NWN:EE models
nwn_blender.description: The command that starts a Blender with the Neverblender add-on, for nwn-model-tooling.

nwn2_blender.title: Blender for NWN2 models
nwn2_blender.description: The command that starts a Blender with the nwn2mdk add-on. Leave blank when NWN2 work is not set up.

nwn_refs.title: Unpacked NWN:EE resources
nwn_refs.description: The folder that holds the stock game resources, unpacked one folder per BIF. Leave blank when there is none.

step_guard.title: No skipped do steps
step_guard.description: Refuse an edit to production code until the session has started do and that do build has approved examples, refuse to mark a do or warp build's pull request ready when do, sentinels or review never ran and the body gives no reason, and remind the agent at do's and warp's start what each step needs.

guard_poll_pace.title: Short polls
guard_poll_pace.description: Refuse a wait that sleeps more than 30 seconds at a time, polls more than 60 times, or loops in the foreground instead of using watch.sh.

lesson_hint.title: Lesson hint
lesson_hint.description: When your message teaches a lesson, such as "codify that" or "for the future", send the agent through engrave before it replies. The full phrase list is in scripts/lesson-hint.sh.

guard_merged_branch.title: No commits on a merged branch
guard_merged_branch.description: Refuse a commit or push on a branch whose remote branch is gone, and name the fresh branch to move to and the commits to carry over.

guard_scratch.title: A scratch folder per subagent
guard_scratch.description: Give each subagent its own scratch folder under /tmp/<session id>/, and refuse a subagent's write to the session folder its siblings share.

guard_rm_steer.title: Spell out the path rm removes
guard_rm_steer.description: Refuse rm -r or rm -f on a path built from a shell variable, and tell the agent to spell the path out, so Claude Code's removal check never stops to ask you.

standing_orders.title: Standing orders
standing_orders.description: Keep a .todo springboard: a hook lists at most five actions only you can take and opens each session on the first, and agents jot short .todo lines for later work without asking. Off: no .todo block, no jotted lines.

guard_take_pick.title: Take the pick
guard_take_pick.description: When the agent ends its turn asking a question it already has a pick for, with no gate behind it, it is sent back once to take the pick and say so, or to gate the question with a watch.

guard_no_v1.title: Never a V1
guard_no_v1.description: An effort ships complete. When the agent ends its turn offering found work as a follow-up pull request, a later ticket or a v2, or asking whether to fold it in, it is sent back once to fold the work in. Work that waits on someone, and a later version the user named, go through.

adr_scope_hint.title: Remind agents what a decision record holds
adr_scope_hint.description: When an agent writes or edits a decision record (adr/NNNN-*.md), add a reminder that a record holds a broad architecture rule, and that one feature's reason goes in a comment at its code.

guard_windowed_browser.title: No browser windows for local pages
guard_windowed_browser.description: Refuse the windowed Playwright browser for a page on this machine, so a by-eye check uses the headless server instead of opening a window on your desktop.

fetch_place_hint.title: Fetched data in a lasting place
fetch_place_hint.description: When a command downloads or unpacks into /tmp, remind the agent that data kept outside git goes in one lasting place every checkout of the project shares.

guard_stale_blame.title: No stale-copy blame without proof
guard_stale_blame.description: When the agent ends its turn blaming your build, client, cache or package as stale, or telling you to update or restart it, with no hash or logged version quoted, it is sent back once to keep tracing the code.

keep_awake.title: Keep the computer awake while an agent works
keep_awake.description: Hold a sleep lock while any Claude Code session on this machine has a turn running, and release it when every turn has ended. Needs systemd-inhibit.

guard_sentinels_first.title: Mutation passes start with sentinels
guard_sentinels_first.description: Refuse a mutation-tool command (Stryker, mutate.sh, mutmut, cargo-mutants, PIT) until the session has started the sentinels skill, which scopes the pass to the changed lines first.

guard_ready_queue.title: Pull requests leave draft one at a time
guard_ready_queue.description: Refuse taking a pull request out of draft (GitHub, Gitea or GitLab) while another one is out of draft or CI runs for another branch.

guard_todo_next.title: A suggested next goes in .todo
guard_todo_next.description: Refuse a write to .todo until the session has started standing-orders, and send back a reply that names what comes next when standing-orders has not run that turn.
